decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Planning statement, Design and Access Statement, Energy Statement (dtd October 2025, by SY Design Studio Ltd), Drainage assessment form, Amenity Space and Urban Greening Factor Statement, Fire Safety Statement - Received 22/10/2025; A000, A001, A002, A101, A102, A103, A104, A105, A106, A107, A108, A109, A110, A111, A112- Received 16/12/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order), no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings/enclosures within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out, other than as shown in the approved drawings, and no additional floor space shall be formed within the building(s) hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division (new mezzanine level) without prior written approval of the local planning authority.
Reason:  To protect neighbours' living conditions and the character and appearance of the area and to prevent over-intensive use of the site.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the Local Planning Authority shall be informed of the agreed naming and numbering of the proposed dwellings so that arrangements can be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of a person eligible for a disabled person's badge issued pursuant to section 21 of the Chronically Sick and Disabled Persons Act 1970 (or similar legislation), no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit. Any occupiers of the approved development shall surrender any such permit wrongly issued or held.
Reason: In order to protect the free flow and safety of traffic on nearby highways and to support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 6 - Prior to occupation and in accordance with dwg A101, the dwelling No.1 hereby approved shall be provided with an Electric Vehicle Charging Point, capable of a minimum output of 7.2kW. The charging point shall be installed and retained as such for the duration of the development without obstruction. 
Reason: In order to promote sustainable modes of transport.

Condition : 7 - Prior to occupation, two cycle parking spaces within secured and enclosed stores, should be provided within each of the dwellings hereby approved. 
Reason: In order to promote sustainable modes of transport.

Condition : 8 - Prior to the occupation of the development and in accordance with approved proposed site plan A101, appropriate fencing no higher than 600mm shall be provided within the subdivided forecourt and front boundary, and the existing rear garden shall be divided with appropriate fencing between the two amenity areas measuring no more than two metres high. It shall be retained as such for the duration of the development.
Reason. In order to protect residents' living conditions and to ensure a satisfactory appearance.

Condition : 9 - Prior to the occupation of the development and in accordance with approved proposed site plan A101, the existing outbuildings within the rear garden must be demolished.
Reason: To ensure adequate amenity area for the occupiers of the dwellings.

Condition : 10 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the existing vehicular access to the south-west of the site, and as annotated on the plans hereby approved to be removed, shall be permanently closed and the kerbs and footway reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement.
Reason: In order to enhance the pedestrian environment and to confine vehicular access to the permitted points in order to ensure that the development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or highway safety along the adjacent highway.
description: Conversion of the existing house into two self-contained units with associated amenity space, cycle and refuse storage, and two off-street parking spaces with EV charging provision
